coverageGaps: No managed getters or runtime collection enumeration.
Raw IActionEnvironment references need an explicit same-process instance/lifecycle join; pooled pointers alone do not establish ownership.
ExecuteInternal observations cover only the selected named consumers; absence is not proof that an action did not run.
No action return, float-register payload, dynamic blackboard, target resolution, IFix, server acceptance or final HP/attribute-write evidence.
BuffData and available SkillData source archives are byte identity only; canonical corpus receipts/native gates decide whether stored schema rows are current.
Per-frame _TriggerInternal is omitted; the journal does not measure continuous tick cadence.
Reset entry fields precede reassignment and may describe a previous pooled instance; supplied BuffData identity and subsequent stored identities remain separate.

Generic AssignData entry registration does not observe its runtime closed type, MethodInfo selection or assignment completion. Selected named consumers separately retain m_data through a current-native closed-layout witness; supplied and stored references remain separate and do not identify serialized nodes.

Initializer entries retain supplied data/environment/skill references. Unique earlier NewAction data/environment entry and later consumer stored references may agree; factory return, assignment completion, lifetime and serialized-node selection remain unobserved. The anonymous DispatchAssignData observer is withdrawn from the active profile after a Capture-only scene-load crash; static dispatch proof does not establish live observer safety.
Skill-environment constructor reference matches preserve incoming skill evidence, not constructor completion, object lifetime or runtime ownership; no IActionEnvironment downcast is permitted.

Selected consumer stored Data indices and bounded configuration leaves can be compared with factory entries and admitted stored-schema candidates. Index/type agreement is conditional; duplicate nodes, unavailable schema, changed payloads or missing reads cannot establish node selection. Dynamic blackboard values and collection contents remain unobserved.

This extension adds named entity-count, global-cooldown and passive-UI entries to the retained baseline recipe. Native preparation does not establish live loading safety or guarantee execution; configured leaves do not observe evaluated counts, durations or UI effects.
evidenceBoundary: Direct bounded Buff lifecycle and selected action entries; stored definition/instance/environment carriers and supplied values remain distinct. Managed reference identity reads retain pointers without dereferencing their objects. Runtime effect meaning and server criteria remain unresolved.
